caption: 💌 SAVE this for your next peaceful snack moment  These Mini Corn Muffins are my go to when I want something soft, nourishing, and toddler-approved 👌no junk, no sugar, just real food and calm energy. ✨ Ingredients ½ cup (60g) corn flour ½ cup (60g) spelt flour ½ cup (50g) grated carrots 🥕 medium one 🥕 ⅔ cup (150 ml) milk 1 egg 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp baking powder ¼ tsp cinnamon 🥣 How to make 1️⃣ Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F). 2️⃣ Mix all ingredients. 3️⃣ Bake for 15–18 min until golden and soft. Perfect warm or cold 👌even for little hands learning to eat independently 🧡 #nosugaradded #calmparenting #toddlersnacks #easyrecipes #toddlernutrition
